name: budget-guard
description: Short-term spend limits for usage-billed Claude Code: a 5-hour cap paced to your monthly budget, enforced on prompts and tool calls.

monthly_budget_usd.title: Monthly budget (USD)
monthly_budget_usd.description: Your Claude Code budget for a calendar month (UTC). The 5-hour cap is derived from it.

pace_multiplier.title: 5-hour cap multiplier
pace_multiplier.description: How many times the even, round-the-clock pace a 5-hour window may spend. 5 suits normal working hours. Higher is looser.
